title: Elon Musk's AGI — The Man Who Builds Rockets and Warns About AI
principle: Entertainment, not claims. This is hypothetical fiction grounded in research.

visionary.name: Elon Musk
visionary.vision: AGI is imminent. Build it yourself to make it safe. Open source as safety.
key_quotes: AGI is significantly higher risk than nuclear weapons.
I now think xAI has a chance of reaching AGI with Grok 5. Never thought that before.
Grok will inherit your thoughts and ideas.
The safest way to build AI is to make one that is maximally curious and truth-seeking.
I hope to die on Mars — but not by impact.
visionary.approach: Build Grok to AGI. Open source. Neuralink for human-AI merger. Optimus for physical labor. SpaceX for backup.
visionary.risk_view: Existential. But building it yourself is safer than letting others build it.
visionary.episode_hook: The man who builds rockets to escape Earth and AI that might destroy it.
